top_signal.title: Building a second location or buying out another small competitor?
top_signal.summary: ​   My wife ran a recovery business for 2 years and it wasn't great. We were debating closing it but I decided to take time off from work to help her full time. We went from taking home between $1,000 and $4,000 per month to averaging now $11,000 in take-home pay. A lot of the changes that we made were really basic: a combination of automation, standard playbooks, and scorecards to help monitor and make decisions (I used to tell her all the things she needed to do, but she always complained she didn't have the time)   Now that here business is reaching capacity we are exploring expanding. But my fear is that she will not have the attention span to be the operator in two locations.    I wonder if I can replicate that turn around with other owners in her space. I.e. would they be open to letting me buy a stake i.e. 50-50. I manage the backend (payroll, invoices, bookkeeping, legal, admind, etc), optimize and automate operations, they focus on delivering the work and we split the profits.   If you as an owner were in that position, would you be open to it?   Or should we resign ourselves to risky/epxnsive location number 2, and hire a studio manager?       submitted by     /u/Crypticarts       [link]       [comments]
